About Us 
At Paytm, we believe in creating exceptional employee experiences through efficient, people-centric HR practices. Our Human Resources team plays a key role in supporting employees, strengthening workplace culture, and ensuring smooth HR operations across the organization. 
 Team Context 
As an HR Intern, you will work closely with the HR team to support day-to-day HR activities, employee coordination, documentation, and HR operations. You will gain practical exposure to corporate HR processes and contribute to creating a positive employee experience. 
 Role Overview 
We are looking for a dynamic, enthusiastic, and proactive HR Intern to support various human resources activities. The intern will assist with HR documentation, employee engagement, maintaining employee records, coordinating HR processes, and supporting the team in routine HR operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Assist the HR team with day-to-day HR operations and administrative activities. 
Maintain and update employee records, HR trackers, and databases. 
Support employee onboarding, documentation, and joining formalities. 
Coordinate with employees and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth HR processes. 
Assist in organizing employee engagement activities and internal initiatives. 
Support attendance tracking, leave records, and other HR-related documentation. 
Help prepare HR reports, maintain data accuracy, and manage confidential employee information responsibly. 
Provide support in employee communication and follow-ups. 
Assist with other HR activities and projects as required by the team. 
 Internship Details 
 Duration: 3–6 Months 
 Location: Ahmedabad 
 Work Mode: Work from Office (5 Days a Week) 
 Exposure & Learning 
This internship offers hands-on exposure to: 
Core HR operations and processes 
Employee onboarding and lifecycle management 
Employee engagement and workplace initiatives 
HR documentation and employee records management 
Attendance, leave management, and HR administration 
Corporate communication and stakeholder coordination 
HR policies, processes, and best practices 
 Skills You Will Develop 
Fundamentals of Human Resources and HR operations 
Employee coordination and communication 
HR documentation and data management 
Stakeholder management and interpersonal skills 
Organization, time management, and attention to detail 
Understanding of HR policies and employee lifecycle processes 
 Learning Outcomes 
By the end of the internship, you will be able to: 
Understand the key functions and responsibilities of an HR team. 
Assist with employee onboarding and routine HR operations. 
Maintain employee records and HR trackers accurately. 
Support employee engagement initiatives and internal HR activities. 
Communicate effectively with employees and internal stakeholders. 
Understand HR processes within a fast-paced corporate environment. 
 Eligibility 
Graduate or currently pursuing graduation in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. 
Strong English communication skills; proficiency in a local language is an advantage. 
Interest in Human Resources, HR Operations, and employee management. 
Good organizational and coordination skills. 
Proactive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 
Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is preferred.

About Us: 
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Job Description – Recruitment Intern / Talent Acquisition Intern 
Role Overview 
We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Recruitment Intern to support the hiring team in identifying and engaging potential candidates from the provided market database. The intern will connect with candidates, convert them into prospective employees, and coordinate interview schedules. 
Duration: 30 Days/60 Days/90 Days 
Location: On-site - Delhi NCR/Bangalore/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Chandigarh/Mohali 
Stipend: As per company norms 
Key Responsibilities 
Utilize the provided database to source and connect with candidates 
Engage and convert potential candidates through calls/emails 
Coordinate and schedule interviews with shortlisted candidates 
Maintain candidate records and follow-up updates 
Support the recruitment team in day-to-day hiring activities 
Exposure & Learning 
This internship offers hands-on exposure to: 
End-to-end recruitment processes 
Talent sourcing and candidate engagement 
Corporate communication and professional networking 
Interview coordination and HR operations 
Real-time hiring workflows used in the industry 
Skills You Will Develop 
Communication & interpersonal skills 
Professional outreach and coordination 
Recruitment and talent acquisition fundamentals 
Time management and stakeholder handling 
Eligibility 
Graduate / Pursuing Graduation 
Strong communication skills(English Must with Local Language) 
Interest in HR & Recruitment 
This internship is designed to make candidates industry-ready with practical corporate hiring experience and real-time exposure to recruitment operations.

https://jobs.lever.co/paytmpayments/839f.title: Intern - Secretarial Compliance - 598
https://jobs.lever.co/paytmpayments/839f.desc:
About Us: 
Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners. 
Expectations/Requirements from the Role: 
1. Assist in drafting and maintaining statutory records, registers, and minutes. 
2. Support in preparing and filing ROC forms and other compliance documents. 
3. Conduct research on legal and regulatory updates relevant to corporate governance. 
4. Coordinate with various departments to ensure timely compliance with statutory obligations. 
5. Assist in board meeting preparation, including agenda drafting and minutes recording. 
6. Helps in dispatching the physical agendas to the Directors place 
7. Visits to ROC or Registrar of office on the need basis 
8. Provide general support to the Company Secretary Team. 
Skills Needed to Succeed in This Role: 
1. Basic understanding of Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI regulations. 
2. Strong drafting and communication skills. 
3. Attention to detail and high level of accuracy. 
4. Proficient in MS Office (especially Word and Excel). 
5. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information. 
6. Good time management and multitasking abilities. 
7. Eagerness to learn and work in a fast-paced corporate environment. 
Why join us: 
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be. 
Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!
